apps.ui_stack_rationale: React Native 启动后由 iOS 解包 Nina.zip。WKWebView 承载本地注册、登录与社区，板点簿、动作日志等深层页面由 React Native 承载。
apps.name_meaning_zh: 用户指定的品牌名 Nina
apps.name_theme_rationale: 用户指定名称，Nina 作为滑板刊物的短刊头。
apps.name_social_rationale: Crew 按真实的板点与练习记录发现同场滑手。
apps.audience: Adult skateboarders building their trick repertoire and returning to familiar skate spots.
apps.product_promise: Turn a line you spotted into a trackable goal and a reason to return to a spot.
apps.main_loop: Browse Lines → save a spot and attach a media reference → log attempts and landings → revisit the spot and see contributing skaters in Crew.
unique_features: Spot Book records obstacle, condition and access notes and connects repeat visits with skaters.
Trick Log records stance, attempt and landing totals, progression and an optional Lines reference.
apps.home_primary_task: Browse a searchable terrain feed, save or comment on a line, report content, post media and open practice from the persistent five-tab shell.
apps.community_content_location: Discover is the first authenticated Tab. The bundled WebView feed opens native media details and a collection gallery without leaving the Tab shell.
apps.user_discovery_location: Crew directory and spot contribution lists within Spot Book.
apps.message_location: Inbox Tab contains Chats, Drafts and Activity. Mutual follows enable persisted messages between profiles stored in this app, with unread events and sender-owned deletion. No cross-device delivery or RTC is connected.
apps.creation_entry: Discover → Post; You → Post a line / Your submissions. Sessions → Add spot / Log tricks / Practice plans.
apps.profile_structure: You Tab contains editable name, bio, stance and avatar, follow relationships, sessions, submissions, saved collection, Wallet and Settings.
apps.showcase_media_direction: Locally supplied skate films and photo essays, with travel and style in Off the Board.
apps.showcase_page_composition: Compact personal header, original social session banner, collection search, horizontal terrain filters, media cards with inline comments, saves and reports; persistent five-item native Dock.
apps.visual_style: Independent skate zine with printed concrete rubbings, pine ink and a grip-yellow action accent.
apps.asset_direction: Host-native Image 2 wheel mascot, original tab grounds and transparent ink icons.
tab_background_directions: Discover: original skate friends campaign and photographic media.
Sessions: curb print, session log, plans and spot book.
Crew: bench ground and actual profile portraits.
Inbox: Crew ground, conversation bubbles and unread activity.
You: Crew ground, evergreen profile card and personal records.
apps.seed_data_direction: Editorial media metadata only. Registered profiles and interaction counts come from actual user actions.
apps.architecture_direction: React Native starts the bundled Nina.zip community in WKWebView. The web feed and native playback share the same extracted media directory. TypeScript owns the journal. Email entry validates the address format and a nonempty password, then opens or creates the matching profile without saving or verifying the password. Keychain stores the local session. UIKit hosts the native Apple features.
apps.theme_mapping: Terrain media suggests a spot and a trick reference. Named spot visits surface actual participating profiles.

toolchain_notes: React 19.3.0, TypeScript 6.0.3, Node 22.17.0, CocoaPods 1.16.2, iPhoneOS SDK 27.1, ZIPFoundation 0.9.20 and the iOS WKWebView host.
